# Dataspecer DCAT application profiles (test oracle)

`dcat3-dap.dsv.ttl` and `dcat2-dap.dsv.ttl` are `dcat-dap/dsv.ttl` and `dcat2-dap/dsv.ttl` of
https://github.com/mff-uk/specifications at commit 833685ef1f5efc845e8901c4ac43e68e0a8b1c98, unmodified,
under the MIT licence in `LICENSE` (Copyright (c) 2025 mff-uk). They are DSV descriptions of W3C DCAT 3 and
DCAT 2 made with Dataspecer; `tests/test_dcat_model_vs_dap.py` uses them to check the class/property models
this tool extracts from the W3C specification texts. Known differences: docs/research/B3-dataspecer-update.md §3.
